sources.title: Vernier — How does a Motion Detector work?
Physics with Vernier, Computer8B Projectile Motion

zh: 平抛：同一时钟，两个方向
水平抛得更快，会更晚落地吗？
en: Horizontal launch: one clock, two directions
Does a faster sideways launch land later?

translations.怎样从不同测量方法确认平抛的两个分运动？: How do different measurements reveal the two parts of horizontal projectile motion?
translations.从频闪、同时释放、复写纸与双接收器测距获得轨迹，再用木板和墙面变式检验规律、测出: Use strobe records, paired release, carbon-paper traces and two-receiver ranging; compare board and wall variants, test the parabola and infer launch speed.
translations.相同时间间隔，水平等距，竖直间距递增: Equal time intervals: equal horizontal spacing, increasing vertical spacing
translations.同高同时释放，平抛与直落同时触地: Same height and release time: horizontal launch and free drop land together
translations.逐次改变挡板高度，留下轨迹点: Change catcher height between trials to record trajectory points
translations.两个接收器测距，交会确定平面位置: Two receiver ranges determine a point in the plane
translations.同一释放位置，改变接球木板高度: Keep the release point and change the catching board height
translations.移动带复写纸的墙面，记录不同位置: Move the carbon-paper wall to record different points
translations.用坐标检验轨迹，不能只看它像不像: Test coordinates rather than judging the curve by appearance
translations.测出高度和水平距离，反求离桌速度: Measure height and horizontal range to recover launch speed
translations.平抛实验 · 同一初始条件: Horizontal projectile lab · Common initial conditions
translations.弹性金属片同时抛出一球并释放另一球: A spring strip launches one ball horizontally while releasing another
translations.运动发射器与两个固定红外超声接收器确定二维位置: A moving emitter and two fixed infrared–ultrasonic receivers locate a point in two dimensions
translations.水平末端斜槽、钢球与对应的轨迹测量装置: A horizontally ending ramp, steel ball and the selected tracing apparatus
translations.取抛出点球心为原点，检验y/x²: Use the ball centre at launch as origin and test y/x²
translations.水平初速度改变落点，不改变同高度的下落时间。: Horizontal speed changes range, not fall time from the same height.
translations.每次都从斜槽同一位置静止释放；不同轨迹点才属于同一条抛物线。: Release from rest at the same ramp point each time so all marks belong to one trajectory.
translations.两个距离有两个镜像交点；已知小球在接收器右侧，才能选定唯一位置。: Two ranges have two mirror intersections; knowing the ball lies right of the receivers selects one.
translations.比值近似恒定支持二次关系；原点必须正确，不能用0/0。: An approximately constant ratio supports a quadratic relation; use the correct origin and exclude 0/0.
translations.高度给出飞行时间，水平距离除以时间得到初速度。: Height determines flight time; horizontal range divided by that time gives launch speed.
translations.等时间水平位移相同；竖直位移与时间的平方对应。: Equal times give equal horizontal travel; vertical drop follows time squared.
translations.理想无气阻；钢球在槽内纯滚动，末端水平。数值是模型数据；描迹按球心位置校正，首次: Ideal drag-free flight; the ball rolls without slipping to a horizontal exit. Values are model data; marks are corrected to ball-centre positions and motion freezes at first contact.
translations.弯曲外形还不够: A curve alone is not enough
translations.已知运动区在右侧: Known region: right of the receivers
translations.刻度尺能给出初速度吗？: Can a ruler reveal launch speed?
translations.平抛的同一时钟、分量速度和新落点预测: A shared clock, velocity components and a new landing prediction
translations.圆对应同一次脉冲的发射位置；超声是单程测距，已知运动区域才排除镜像点。: Both circles refer to the same emission event. Ultrasound travels one way; the known region excludes the mirror point.
translations.理想模型不含空气阻力；在首次接触时停止，不模拟碰撞后的运动。球心是各坐标的共同基: This ideal model omits air resistance and stops at first contact. All coordinates refer to the ball centre; post-impact motion is not modeled.
translations.平抛：同一时钟，两个方向: Horizontal launch: one clock, two directions
translations.水平抛得更快，会更晚落地吗？: Does a faster sideways launch land later?
translations.跟住同一时钟下的钢球，从等时位置与速度分量解释平抛，再预测新高度的落点。: Follow one ball and one clock: use timed positions and velocity components to explain horizontal launch, then predict a new landing height.
translations.同一时钟：水平等距，竖直间距增大。: One clock: equal horizontal steps, growing vertical steps.
translations.同高度、同时释放，两球始终同高。: Same height and release time: both balls stay level.
translations.下落量给出时间，再检验水平位移。: Recover time, then compare horizontal steps.
translations.重力改变竖直速度，水平速度保持不变。: Gravity changes vertical velocity; horizontal velocity stays constant.
translations.降低接球板后，新的落点在哪里？: Lower the catcher: where will the ball land?
translations.墙移远以后，小球会多下降多少？: Move the wall farther: how much farther will the ball drop?
translations.用两个分运动推导轨迹，再预测新点。: Derive the path from both motions, then predict a new point.
translations.高度给出时间，距离给出速度，再预测新高度。: Height gives time, range gives speed, then predict a new height.

cues.title: 同一串等时点
cues.caption: 同一时钟：水平等距，竖直间距增大。
cues.captionEn: One clock: equal horizontal steps, growing vertical steps.
cues.zh: 先用频闪或逐帧视频记录小球的位置。本例每零点零五秒留下一个位置点。把抛出点的球心作为原点，向右和向下建立坐标。相同时间内，水平位移相同，竖直位移却逐次增大。这些位置记录让我们分别研究两个方向，而不是仅仅凭一条弯曲的外形猜测运动规律。
cues.en: Begin with strobe photography or video frames. This example records a point every 0.05 seconds. Use the ball centre at launch as the origin, with axes right and down. Equal intervals have equal horizontal travel but increasing vertical travel. Position records let us study each direction separately rather than guessing a law from the curve’s appearance.

cues.title: 抛得更快，会落得更晚吗？
cues.caption: 同高度、同时释放，两球始终同高。
cues.captionEn: Same height and release time: both balls stay level.
cues.zh: 教材的弹性金属片同时完成两件事：把一球水平抛出，并释放另一球自由下落。两球起始高度相同，竖直初速度都为零。虽然水平位置越来越远，它们的高度始终相同，并且同时触地。改变水平投射强度会改变落点，却不改变同高度的下落时间；这为平抛的竖直分运动提供了直接对照。
cues.en: The spring-strip apparatus launches one ball horizontally while releasing another vertically. Both start at the same height and instant, with zero vertical velocity. Their horizontal positions separate, but their heights match and they land together. Changing horizontal launch strength changes range, not fall time from the same height. This directly tests the vertical component.

cues.title: 轨迹怎样给出时间
cues.caption: 下落量给出时间，再检验水平位移。
cues.captionEn: Recover time, then compare horizontal steps.
cues.zh: 轨迹本身不带时钟。用竖直自由落体规律，把球心下降量换成飞行时间。这组理想教学坐标中，时间每次增加零点一秒，水平位移每次增加零点一四米，所以水平速度保持一点四米每秒。真实描点必须保持同一初速度，不能把不同条件的印迹拼在一起。
cues.en: A path has no clock. Use vertical free fall to convert centre drop into flight time. In these ideal teaching coordinates, time increases by zero point one seconds, while horizontal position increases by zero point one four metres. Horizontal speed is therefore constant at one point four metres per second. Real marks must share the same launch conditions.

cues.title: 为什么只改变一个分量
cues.caption: 重力改变竖直速度，水平速度保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Gravity changes vertical velocity; horizontal velocity stays constant.
cues.zh: 跟住同一个球。离开装置后，忽略空气阻力，只有重力向下。水平合力为零，加速度也为零，已有的水平速度不需要持续推力来维持。重力使竖直速度每秒增加九点八米每秒。看速度三角形：水平边不变，竖直边变长，总速度转向下方。两个分运动共用一个时钟，合成这个球的运动。
cues.en: Follow the ball. After release, ignoring air resistance, only gravity acts downward. Zero horizontal force means zero horizontal acceleration; existing horizontal velocity needs no sustained push. Gravity increases vertical velocity by nine point eight metres per second each second. In the velocity triangle, the horizontal side stays fixed, the vertical side grows, and their sum turns downward. Both components share one clock.

cues.title: 新高度的新落点
cues.caption: 降低接球板后，新的落点在哪里？
cues.captionEn: Lower the catcher: where will the ball land?
cues.zh: 先看小球落到较高的接球板上。初速度不变，把球心下降量变成四倍，水平距离也会变成四倍吗？先停一下。下降量与时间平方成正比，所以飞行时间只加倍；水平速度不变，水平距离也只加倍。放好空心预测标记，再释放小球。它到达标记处才接触接球板。
cues.en: First the ball reaches the higher board. Keep launch speed, but quadruple the centre drop. Will horizontal distance also quadruple? Pause here. Drop grows with time squared, so flight time only doubles. Unchanged horizontal speed then doubles the range. Place the outlined prediction, then release the ball. It reaches the mark at first contact.

cues.title: 墙移远以后
cues.caption: 墙移远以后，小球会多下降多少？
cues.captionEn: Move the wall farther: how much farther will the ball drop?
cues.zh: 保留近处的撞点，把到墙前的球心水平位移加倍。下降量会加倍，还是变成四倍？水平速度不变，飞行时间加倍；下降量随时间平方变化，因此变成四倍。空心标记先预测，随后释放检验理想模型。墙面距离要扣除球半径，才是球心位移。首次接触就停下，不模拟碰撞后的运动。
cues.en: Keep the first mark and double the centre travel to the wall. Will the drop double or quadruple? Constant horizontal velocity doubles flight time. Drop grows with time squared, so it quadruples. Place the prediction, then release to check the ideal model. Subtract the ball radius from wall-surface distance to obtain centre travel. Stop at first contact; post-impact motion is not modeled.

cues.title: 为什么是抛物线
cues.caption: 用两个分运动推导轨迹，再预测新点。
cues.captionEn: Derive the path from both motions, then predict a new point.
cues.zh: 一条线看起来弯曲，还不能说明它就是抛物线。把原点放在抛出时的球心，向下为正，看这组固定的理想教学坐标。先试竖直位移与水平位移成正比，直线跟不上后面的点。再除以水平位移的平方，比值都为二点五每米。为什么？水平位移等于初速度乘时间，竖直位移等于二分之一重力加速度乘时间平方。消去同一个时间，就得到竖直位移与水平位移平方成正比。现在先遮住最后一点：水平位移零点五六米，预测下降零点七八四米。再揭开这个固定点。它展示模型的预测关系，不是新增的实验证据。
cues.en: A curved line is not automatically a parabola. Put the origin at the launch centre, with downward positive, and inspect these fixed ideal teaching coordinates. First try a linear relation. The line misses the later points. Dividing vertical displacement by horizontal displacement squared gives two point five per metre. Why? Horizontal displacement is launch speed times time; vertical displacement is half gravity times time squared. Eliminate the shared time to obtain the quadratic relation. Keep the last point hidden. At a horizontal distance of zero point five six metres, predict a drop of zero point seven eight four metres. Now reveal it. This illustrates the model, not new experimental evidence.

cues.title: 刻度尺看见初速度
cues.caption: 高度给出时间，距离给出速度，再预测新高度。
cues.captionEn: Height gives time, range gives speed, then predict a new height.
cues.zh: 如果没有计时器，只有刻度尺，能求出离桌速度吗？先测桌面到水平接球面的高度零点八零米，以及从抛出点正下方到落点的水平距离零点五六米。对同一个球，起点和终点的半径偏移相互抵消，这个高度正是球心下降量。因为球水平离桌，竖直初速度为零，高度给出飞行时间，约零点四零四秒。水平距离除以时间，得到初速度约一点三八六米每秒，不需要知道斜槽中的摩擦。现在保持这个速度，把接球面提高到下降量只有零点二零米。先预测：时间变成一半，落点应在零点二八米处。放好空心标记，再让小球飞出。
cues.en: Can a ruler reveal launch speed without a timer? Measure a height of zero point eight zero metres and a horizontal range of zero point five six metres. With the same ball on horizontal support surfaces, the radius offsets at both ends cancel, so this height is also the centre drop. A horizontal launch has zero initial vertical velocity. The height gives a flight time of about zero point four zero four seconds. Range divided by time gives about one point three eight six metres per second, without knowing ramp friction. Keep that speed and raise the catcher so the drop is only zero point two zero metres. Predict first: half the time means a range of zero point two eight metres. Place the outline, then launch.
